stem:
Meena, a dentist in Jaipur, wants to see an enlarged image of a patient's tooth during an examination.
Which optical element should she use, and why?

options.text: A plane mirror, because it always gives an enlarged image
A concave mirror, because it gives an enlarged image when the tooth is held close to it
A convex mirror, because it gives an enlarged image of the tooth
A convex lens, because it spreads the light evenly over the tooth

teacher.key_rationale: A concave mirror produces an upright, enlarged image when the object is within its focal length, which is why dentists use concave mirrors for close inspection. Plane and convex mirrors give same-size or diminished images; a convex lens is not used as a dental inspection mirror.
